senses.gloss: The third letter of the second class of consonants, corresponding to the letter J in jet.

mfn. (जः जा जं)
1 Speedy, swift.
2 Eaten.
3 Victorious, triumphant, conquering or a conqueror.
m. (-जः)
1 A name of ŚIVA.
2 A name of VIṢṆU.
3 Birth, production.
4 A parent, a progenitor.
5 Poison.
6 Enjoyment.
7 Light, lustre.
8 Speed.
9 An imp, a goblin.
E.
जन to bear or be born, जि to conquer, or other roots, and ड aff.
